# Dough Intent Coverage — SEED-371

**Verdict: Caught.**

Checked `SEED-371#run-and-maintain-native-evaluations-as-a-distinct-distribution-tool` at `3163559cf0f13169f136b0a195aeb4754bd63499`, against `.planning/seeds/SEED-371-distribution-evaluation-tool.md`: an ordinary run includes guidance and evaluation-tool checks in the existing Distribution proof. This check covers omission of the whole evaluation discovery root; it makes no claim about every possible selective omission. The developer-skipped optimization and named-aggregate performance requirement were not tested or changed.

In an independent scratch clone at that exact revision, the one semantic fault replaced `test_roots+=(Distribution/evaluation/tests)` with a valid no-op inside the default-root branch of `scripts/test-jobs.sh:45`. Fixtures and assertions were unchanged. The initial literal-deletion representation produced an empty Bash branch and manifest exit 2, so it supplied no coverage verdict; it was restored before the valid probe and fresh passing baseline.

Maintained proof command, identical for the valid baseline, fault and restored runs:

```sh
PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH OPEN_DOUGH_TEST_JOBS=1 caffeinate -s -i bash scripts/test.sh Distribution/tests/test-runner/test-runner-selection.sh
```

Baseline exited 0. An independent actual-source manifest from `OPEN_DOUGH_TEST_DIR=Distribution/tests bash scripts/test-jobs.sh` contained 641 unique jobs, including 70 evaluation and 570 guidance jobs plus the installation check. With the fault, that same manifest command succeeded but returned 571 unique jobs and zero evaluation jobs, while retaining all 570 guidance jobs. This independently establishes wrong behavior on the intended default discovery path, rather than merely proving the edit executed.

The maintained check then exited 1. Its actual-source all/split discovery section and independent `directJobs` expectations at `Distribution/tests/test-runner/test-runner-selection.sh:142` caught the missing `Distribution/evaluation/tests/git-publication/git-publication-native-one-shot-results.sh`: `expectCount(job, 1)` observed `0 !== 1` in the all listing. These are maintained expected jobs, not answers supplied by the temporary fault. The check also prepares its existing private selection/marker fixtures; no new fixture or assertion was added.

I restored the exact original script bytes, verified its SHA256 `16495159eb54b8392836a26a67952487d234b5b0a6c5a5aac5e1c3bac08c6c4d`, verified the scratch HEAD and clean Git status matched pre-probe state, reran the same proof command to exit 0, and independently recovered the original 641/70/570 manifest. The independent clone was removed after verification; all logs, manifests, fault diff, source backup and cleanup record remain under `/tmp/seed371-intent-evcilgw2/`. The root execution checkout was not edited. Cleanup's initial path-identity assertion required normalizing macOS `/tmp` and `/private/tmp`; the normalized ownership check passed before deletion.

Setup used the maintained `node scripts/setup-native.mjs npm` in scratch; acquisition passed. No copied node_modules or browser setup was used. Actual runtime was Node 24.21.0 and Bash 5.3.20 on the shared 16-core Mac, AC100%, load 2.89 and 68% free memory. Named commands ran with one worker under `caffeinate -s -i`; no whole-suite run, paid native session, timeout change or optimization was performed. MakeMe selection was resolved true, PageObjects false; the existing selected test and fixtures remained unchanged. The shared failure policy applies: `Distribution/src/skills/dough-execute-plan/references/failure-policy.md`.

**Next proof action:** No new or stronger proof is required for this probed complete-root omission. Retain the existing discovery assertion. This confirms an already-delivered default-discovery protection rather than making a new repair decision; the skipped G7 optimization disposition remains separate.

- **Test runtime.** Measured focused-command wall times: valid baseline 1.486 s, fault 1.542 s, restored 1.678 s; total 4.706 s. The earlier invalid-injection construction also ran passing baseline/restored checks at 1.563/1.446 s, making all five focused invocations total 7.715 s. The runner emits no separate internal-duration figure; these measurements include the command wrapper.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable: no separate developer activity/time measurement was collected during this automatic probe.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable: the host supplied no separate active-agent time or token meter; invocation elapsed is reported separately rather than treated as agent effort.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 469635 ms (measured), from 1794784115000 to 1794784584635 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

Wrap-up disposition: Checked3163559cf0f13169f136b0a195aeb4754bd63499; Caught for complete evaluation-root omission. Existing maintained discovery assertion detects the independently observed wrong default manifest; no new or stronger proof and no follow-up are required for this probed fault. No claim covers every selective omission; G7 optimization remains explicitly skipped.
